result.title: Domain-Tuned Diffusion Super-Resolution for 4K Facial Asset Maps
result.comment: Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications. 4 pages
result.summary: Physically based facial assets require 4K albedo and displacement maps for cinematic close-ups, yet generative pipelines commonly produce them at only 1K. Naively applying photographic super-resolution is a poor fit: facial UV maps have domain-specific statistics, and displacement is a scalar height field whose errors directly distort geometry. We present a domain-tuned diffusion upscaler for 4x (1024 to 4096) facial asset super-resolution. Starting from a bilinearly upsampled map, we adapt a frozen SDXL backbone per modality with lightweight LoRA modules, while a Tile ControlNet preserves input structure as the diffusion prior restores pore- and wrinkle-scale detail. On held-out maps, our method produces sharper, more faithful detail than bilinear and off-the-shelf GAN and diffusion super-resolvers, reducing albedo LPIPS from 0.21 to 0.08 while avoiding misplaced or excessive displacement relief. These results show that lightweight domain adaptation can produce render-ready 4K facial asset maps without a custom super-resolution architecture.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向 4K 面部资产贴图（albedo 与 displacement UV 图）的超分辨率，在冻结 SDXL 上以 LoRA 做模态特定微调，并用 Tile ControlNet 保留输入结构，实现 1024 到 4096 的 4 倍放大。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于图像生成与资产放大任务，虽然涉及视觉细节保真，但不研究多模态推理中的内部状态、证据获取或停止决策，未见可供 LVR 核查的状态或监督线索。
